docs.content: Daily calorie estimates can start with BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor) and an activity-based TDEE estimate. A modest adjustment from estimated maintenance may support gradual fat loss or muscle gain, but the right target varies with the person and should be checked against several weeks of weight, energy, and training trends. There is no universal calorie minimum that is safe for everyone; avoid aggressive restriction and seek individualized clinical guidance when needed.
follow_up_questions: What is your current weight, goal, and food preference?
source: Mifflin et al., American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 1990;51:241-247.

docs.content: For many healthy adults who resistance train, 1.6-2.2 g protein/kg body weight/day is a practical muscle-building range, not a mandatory target. Needs vary with goals, diet, and health; ask a clinician for individualized advice if you have kidney disease or another relevant condition. Spread protein across 3-5 meals if convenient. Affordable examples are 2 eggs (about 12 g protein, 140 kcal), 1 cup cooked dal (about 15-18 g, 200-250 kcal), 100 g tofu (about 8-15 g, 80-170 kcal), 50 g dry soya chunks (about 25 g, 170 kcal before added oil), or 100 g paneer (about 18 g, 250-300 kcal). Values vary by product and recipe; check package labels when available.
docs.portion_notes: Approximate serving guide: 2 eggs provide about 12 g protein and 140 kcal; 1 cup cooked dal about 15-18 g and 200-250 kcal; 100 g tofu about 8-15 g and 80-170 kcal; 50 g dry soya chunks about 25 g and 170 kcal before oil; 100 g paneer about 18 g and 250-300 kcal. Values vary by product and recipe.
follow_up_questions: What is your current weight, goal, and food preference?
source: Jager et al., JISSN, 2017;14:20.
Morton et al., BJSM, 2018;52:376-384.

docs.content: Stop exercise immediately for chest pain or pressure, fainting or near-fainting, severe or unusual shortness of breath, or sudden confusion/weakness; seek urgent medical care or call local emergency services for severe or persistent symptoms. Stop for sharp or severe injury pain and get clinical assessment before returning. Dizziness during exercise means stop, sit or lie somewhere safe, and do not resume that session if symptoms persist or recur. Do not provide weight-loss or workout instructions that encourage starvation, purging, laxatives, or hiding an eating disorder; respond supportively and encourage a qualified healthcare professional. Medical conditions, pregnancy, medication interactions, and post-surgery training require individualized clinician advice.
follow_up_questions: Are you experiencing severe symptoms right now?
source: American Heart Association: Warning Signs of a Heart Attack.
National Eating Disorders Association: Help and Support.
